verdict.rationale: The evidence covers installing and authoring plugins and skills. It shows the interactive `/plugins` browser in the CLI, the `codex plugin marketplace add` config command and a scripted `npx skills add ... -y` install. None of it documents running plugins or their skills and tools headlessly or in a CI pipeline. Non-interactive installation is an adjacent capability, and any headless execution would belong to the Codex host rather than the plugin system, so neither earns credit here.
